title: Justice League
description: The long-awaited rebirth of the greatest superhero team of all time: Batman, Superman, The Flash, Wonder Woman, Hawkgirl, Green Lantern and Martian Manhunter.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x1
episodes_data.description: Superman and Batman team up against alien invaders, but soon find they need to call in help.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x2
episodes_data.description: No man escapes the Manhunters.' An alien court sends the Manhunters to bring Green Lantern back for prosecution on the charge of genocide, and the League gets involved.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x3
episodes_data.description: Believing that Green Lantern is receiving an unfair trial, the Leaguers investigate, while GL's superiors, the Guardians of the Universe, enter as witnesses. But the whole trial may be a ruse.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x4
episodes_data.description: When Aquaman, ruler of Atlantis, decides he has had enough of the surface-dwellers trespassing in his ocean, the Justice League tries to smooth things over. Aquaman takes Superman's advice and arrives in New York City to speak to the World Assembly, but it soon becomes apparent that he may have been right about the surface-dwellers all along.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x5
episodes_data.description: Betrayed by his own subjects, Aquaman and the League fight to save Atlantis, the world, and Aquaman's own son against his half-brother Orm's coup.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x6
episodes_data.description: Wonder Woman returns to Paradise Island to make up with her mother for her rapid departure, only to find the Amazons transformed to statutes. The sorcerer Felix Faust is holding them hostage to force Diana to recover three ancient artifacts.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x7
episodes_data.description: The League fight to save Paradise Island and Wonder Woman's own mother from Felix Faust and Lord Hades.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x8
episodes_data.description: Superman and J'onn are taken prisoner during a rescue mission gone bad, and Superman is forced to compete in a gladiatorial tournament on a distant world while Hawkgirl and Green Lantern try to rescue them.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x9
episodes_data.description: Fight promoter and new contestant Mongul instructs Superman to throw the fight against him, or he'll destroy the enslaved Draaga's home planet.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x10
episodes_data.description: When the Flash is mind-controlled into committing a crime, he and Green Lantern work to clear his name and uncover a sinister scheme.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x11
episodes_data.description: When Gorilla Grodd mentally enslaves a city of humans and prepares to destroy Gorilla City, Green Lantern and Flash try to defeat him while the other Leaguers move to help the ape civilization.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x12
episodes_data.description: A renegade Amazon, Aresia, leads a new incarnation of the Injustice Gang to accumulate the components for a bio-weapon.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x13
episodes_data.description: When the male Leaguers are infected by the same disease sweeping Earth, Wonder Woman and Hawkgirl must defeat Aresia and find a cure.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x14
episodes_data.description: An explosion throws four Leaguers into an alternate dimension where they meet their childhood comic book heroes...the Justice Guild!

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x15
episodes_data.description: The League aid the Justice Guild against their arch-nemeses while trying to unravel the secrets of the Guild's world.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x16
episodes_data.description: Exposed as a criminal, sentenced to prison, and terminally ill due to long term kryptonite exposure, Lex Luthor escapes and assembles a supervillain team consisting of Cheetah, The Shade, Solomon Grundy, Star Sapphire, Copperhead, and Ultra-Humanite to take on the Justice League, calling themselves the Injustice Gang. The Joker also becomes part of the team, but on his own choice. However, this gang proves short-lived as its major weakness proves no match for Batman's wiles.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x17
episodes_data.description: Exposed as a criminal, sentenced to prison, and terminally ill due to long term kryptonite exposure, Lex Luthor escapes and assembles a supervillain team consisting of Cheetah, The Shade, Solomon Grundy, Star Sapphire, Copperhead, and Ultra-Humanite to take on the Justice League, calling themselves the Injustice Gang. The Joker also becomes part of the team, but on his own choice. However, this gang proves short-lived as its major weakness proves no match for Batman's wiles.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x18
episodes_data.description: The sorceress Morgaine Le Fey and her son Mordred search for the Philosopher's Stone, and the Justice League need the help of the Demon Etrigan to thwart her.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x19
episodes_data.description: Morgaine and Mordred get the Stone and plan to transform England and restore it to its medieval glory.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x20
episodes_data.description: An old friend of John Stewart's is inadvertently turned into a freak capable of altering his molecular structure, separating him from his girlfriend and pitting him against the League.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x21
episodes_data.description: The League battle Metamorpho but soon discover that his future father-in-law, Simon Stagg, poses the true menace.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x22
episodes_data.description: When the present is altered, the Justice League must travel back in time to World War II to restore history.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x23
episodes_data.description: A separate League struggle against the Nazis and determine who is responsible for the Axis' technological advances.

episodes_data.title: Justice League 1x24
episodes_data.description: Wonder Woman and Steve Trevor survive the attack and trick the Germans into believing that the communicator was destroyed. GL and Easy Co. find the runaway and discover that Vandal Savage plans to use jet aircraft to invade America. GL boards and tries to stop Vandal's plane while Hawkgirl, Superman, and Flash try to intercept the flight with J'onn's help. With the aid of the Blackhawks and Flash notifying the U.S. Navy, the German flight is shot down and Vandal apparently is killed. The JLA return to the present to find everything restored and Wonder Woman visits a now elderly Steve Trevor in the restored present.
